figures.caption: Tē 11 tô.—2. Tē it kēng-chui-kut téng-bīn pêng : a, chêng-keng ; e, aū-koan-chat-o, chit-ê sī kap tē 2 kēng-chui-kut ê khí-chōng-tút-khí lâi chòe koan-chat ; f, hoâin-tút-khí-khang ; g, siōng-koan-chat-o ; k, chí-bēng hoâin-jīm-tài, liân ê só͘-chāi ; l, chui-khang (Blackie and Son).

Tē 12 tô.—3. Tē jī kēng-chui-kut thâu-chêng bīn : c, b, e, khí-chōng-tút-khí ê thâu, tiong kap bé ; d, chêng-koan-chat-o, sī kap tē it kēng-chui-kut aū-koan-chat-o lâi chòe koan-chat ; g, siōng hā koan-chat-o (Blackie and Son).
